```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
source("00-paths.R")
```

# Load data

```{r}
cytofile.1<- "../data/raw/cytokines/13-2_20211209_173456.csv"
cytofile.2 <- "../data/raw/cytokines/New Batch 3_20211207_210206.csv"
```

```{r}
cv.tab1 <- read.csv(cytofile.1, skip = 699)[1:47,]
cv.tab2 <- read.csv(cytofile.2, skip = 699)[1:47,]

res.tab1 <- read.csv(cytofile.1, skip = 351)[1:96,]
res.tab2 <- read.csv(cytofile.2, skip = 351)[1:96,]
```

# Quick plots

```{r}
cv.box1 <- cv.tab1 %>%
  gather(-Sample, key = "cytokine", value = "CVpercent") %>%
  mutate(CVpercent = as.numeric(CVpercent))

cv.box1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CVpercent)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(cytokine), scales = "free") +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../figures/histogram_cv-percent_batch1.png")

cv.tab2 %>%
  gather(-Sample, key = "cytokine", value = "CVpercent") %>%
  mutate(CVpercent = as.numeric(CVpercent)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CVpercent)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(cytokine), scales = "free") +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../figures/histogram_cv-percent_batch2.png")
```

```{r}
res.tab1.box <-  res.tab1%>%
  filter(!grepl("Standard", Sample)) %>%
  gather(-Sample, -Location, -Total.Events, key = "cytokine", value = "result") %>%
  # filter(cytokine != "Cystatin.C") %>%
  mutate(result = as.numeric(result)) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(iqr = IQR(result, na.rm = T),
         is.outlier = (result > quantile(result,.75,na.rm = T ) + 1.5*iqr)|(result < quantile(result,.25,na.rm = T ) - 1.5*iqr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(slab = ifelse(is.outlier == T, Sample, NA))

res.tab1.box %>%
  mutate(compcom = ifelse(grepl("Complement", cytokine), T,F)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cytokine, y = result, label = slab)) +
  # facet_wrap(~cytokine, scales = "free") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("../figures/boxplot_cytokine-results.png")

```

# IQR outliers

```{r catch up second batch}
res.tab2.box <-  res.tab2%>%
  filter(!grepl("Standard", Sample)) %>%
  gather(-Sample, -Location, -Total.Events, key = "cytokine", value = "result") %>%
  # filter(cytokine != "Cystatin.C") %>%
  mutate(result = as.numeric(result)) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(iqr = IQR(result, na.rm = T),
         is.outlier = (result > quantile(result,.75,na.rm = T ) + 1.5*iqr)|(result < quantile(result,.25,na.rm = T ) - 1.5*iqr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(slab = ifelse(is.outlier == T, Sample, NA))
```

```{r define cv outliers}
cv.out1 <- cv.box1 %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(CV.iqr = IQR(CVpercent, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(CV.outlier =  (CVpercent > quantile(CVpercent,.75,na.rm = T ) + 1.5*CV.iqr)) %>%
  select(Sample, cytokine, CV.outlier)

cv.out2 <- cv.tab2 %>%
  gather(-Sample, key = "cytokine", value = "CVpercent") %>%
  mutate(CVpercent = as.numeric(CVpercent)) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(CV.iqr = IQR(CVpercent, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(CV.outlier =  (CVpercent > quantile(CVpercent,.75,na.rm = T ) + 1.5*CV.iqr)) %>%
  select(Sample, cytokine, CV.outlier)
```

```{r table of outlier conditions}
res.out.b1 <- res.tab1.box %>%
  select(Sample, Location, cytokine, is.outlier) %>%
  left_join(cv.out1) %>%
  mutate(combined.outlier = is.outlier == T & CV.outlier == T) %>%
  filter(combined.outlier == T)

res.out.b2 <- res.tab2.box %>%
  select(Sample, Location, cytokine, is.outlier) %>%
  left_join(cv.out2) %>%
  mutate(combined.outlier = is.outlier == T & CV.outlier == T) %>%
  filter(combined.outlier == T)

```

# Remove outliers and get final values

```{r}
res.good.1 <- res.tab1.box %>%
  anti_join(res.out.b1) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Background", Sample)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, cytokine) %>%
  summarize(avg.res = mean(result, na.rm = T))

res.good.2 <- res.tab2.box %>%
  anti_join(res.out.b2) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Background", Sample)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, cytokine) %>%
  summarize(avg.res = mean(result, na.rm = T))

avg.results.tab <- bind_rows(res.good.1, res.good.2)
```

```{r}
write.csv(avg.results.tab, "../data/derived/cytokines_avg-results.csv")
```
